name: Supermilk Biscuits
ingredients: MAIDA REFINED WHEAT FLOUR) (57.4%), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, SWE CONDENSED COW MILK 30% INVERT SYRUP, IODIZED SALT, RAISING AGENTS [500(ii), 503 (ii)], MILK (0.36%) (OF WHICH 02% DOMESTIC COW MILK), EMULSIFIERS [MONO AND DIGLYCERIDES OF FATT FLAVORING SUBSTANCES (MILK. MAY CONTAIN NUT.
